dockztorm - 11-in-1 rgb docking station.name: Dockztorm - 11-in-1 RGB Docking Station for ROG Xbox Ally, ROG Ally X, ROG Ally, Steam Deck (OLED), Legion Go, MSI Claw
dockztorm - 11-in-1 rgb docking station.description: Build a more powerful desktop-style setup for your ROG Ally with the Dockztorm 11-in-1 RGB Gaming Dock. Designed for ROG Ally, ROG Ally X, and ROG Xbox Ally series, this dock lets you connect your handheld to a monitor, keyboard, mouse, controller, wired network, storage devices, and memory cards to create a cleaner Windows handheld gaming station. HDMI supports up to 4K@120Hz output on compatible monitors or TVs, helping FPS, racing, action, and AAA games feel smoother and more immersive on a larger display. The 140W PD input supports pass-through charging while gaming with a monitor and accessories connected. Actual charging power depends on your handheld device, charger, USB-C cable, and system power limit. The 11-in-1 design means 10 physical ports plus RGB lighting, not 11 ports. Ports include USB-C host, USB-C 10Gbps data, USB-A 10Gbps, two USB-A 5Gbps ports, HDMI, RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet, USB-C PD input, SD card slot, and TF/microSD card slot. It is ideal for external SSDs, USB drives, keyboards, mice, controllers, Ethernet, and SD/TF card access. Built-in RGB lighting turns on automatically when powered, adding a stronger gaming atmosphere to your desk. The included TF card comes with the OpenRGB installer, allowing you to customize lighting effects or turn RGB off when needed. The adjustable stand design supports multiple viewing angles and helps keep your handheld positioned for desktop play and airflow. Compatible with ROG Ally, ROG Ally X, ROG Xbox Ally series, Steam Deck, Steam Deck OLED, Legion Go, MSI Claw, and other USB-C handhelds that support video output and USB Power Delivery. Package includes: Dockztorm Gaming Dock, USB-C cable, TF card with OpenRGB installer, user manual, and warranty card. Handheld device, charger, HDMI cable, monitor, keyboard, mouse, controller, and other accessories are for demonstration only and are not included.
